title: Carry over sticky activation for same-origin navs and traversals
body: See discussion in https://github.com/WICG/view-transitions/issues/239 and https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11328#issuecomment-2937353307. Details: - To avoid encouraging racy code, this is sticky activation only, not transient activation. This requires adding the "has sticky activation" boolean to the user activation data model. - This does not propagate the information to iframes or parent frames. It is only for the navigated frame (which can be an iframe), and it copies from its predecessor Window in that same frame. - This works for push/replace navigations, reloads, and both bfcached and non-bfcached traversals, except for iframes recreated during non-bfcache traversals. - Reloads reuse the entry's document state, which describes the original navigation, so they only check whether the reload itself was redirected cross-origin. - Unless reloading, the destination entry must have a same-origin initiator origin (excluding navigations initiated by a cross-origin document or browser UI) and must not have been created via cross-origin redirects. To make the latter hold after bfcache eviction, a "was created via cross-origin redirects" bit is added to document state. - history-action user activation is redefined as a simple boolean instead of comparing timestamps, fixing a bug where consuming transient activation re-granted history-action activation without a new user gesture. --- /cc @mustaqahmed @nickcoury --- -
